#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <climits>

using namespace std;

class ArrayUtils {
public:
    static void fill(vector<vector<int>>& array, int value) {
        for (auto& row : array) {
            fill(row.begin(), row.end(), value);
        }
    }

    static void fill(vector<vector<vector<int>>>& array, int value) {
        for (auto& subArray : array) {
            fill(subArray, value);
        }
    }
};

class InputReader {
public:
    explicit InputReader() : buffer(1024), pos(0), size(0) {}

    int readInt() {
        int c = readChar();
        while (isSpaceChar(c)) {
            c = readChar();
        }
        int sgn = 1;
        if (c == '-') {
            sgn = -1;
            c = readChar();
        }
        int res = 0;
        do {
            if (c < '0' || c > '9') {
                throw invalid_argument("Invalid input");
            }
            res = res * 10 + c - '0';
            c = readChar();
        } while (!isSpaceChar(c));
        return res * sgn;
    }

    int readChar() {
        if (pos >= size) {
            size = fread(buffer.data(), 1, buffer.size(), stdin);
            pos = 0;
            if (size == 0) return -1;
        }
        return buffer[pos++];
    }

private:
    vector<char> buffer;
    size_t pos;
    size_t size;

    static bool isSpaceChar(int c) {
        return c == ' ' || c == '\n' || c == '\r' || c == '\t' || c == -1;
    }
};

class OutputWriter {
public:
    explicit OutputWriter() {}

    void printLine(long long i) {
        cout << i << "\n";
    }

    void printLine(int i) {
        cout << i << "\n";
    }
};

class BLittleCLoves3II {
public:
    vector<vector<vector<int>>> answer;
    long long n, m;
    int n_int, m_int;

    long long solve(long long testNumber, InputReader& in, OutputWriter& out) {
        n = in.readInt();
        m = in.readInt();
        if (n > m) {
            swap(n, m);
        }
        n_int = static_cast<int>(n);
        m_int = static_cast<int>(m);

        if (n == 1) {
            long long x = m % 6;
            if (x <= 3) {
                out.printLine(m - x);
                return m - x;
            }
            if (x == 4) {
                out.printLine(m - 2);
                return m - 2;
            }
            out.printLine(m - 1);
            return m - 1;
        }

        if (n <= 5 && m <= 30) {
            int max_mask = 1 << (3 * n_int);
            answer.assign(m_int + 1, vector<vector<int>>(n_int + 1, vector<int>(max_mask, -1)));
            int res = go(0, 0, 0);
            out.printLine(res);
            return res;
        } else {
            out.printLine(n * m - (n * m % 2));
            return n * m - (n * m % 2);
        }
    }

private:
    int go(int row, int col, int mask) {
        if (answer[row][col][mask] != -1) {
            return answer[row][col][mask];
        }
        if (row == m_int) {
            return answer[row][col][mask] = (mask == 0) ? 0 : INT_MIN;
        }
        if (col == n_int) {
            return answer[row][col][mask] = go(row + 1, 0, mask);
        }
        if ((mask & 1) == 1) {
            return answer[row][col][mask] = go(row, col + 1, mask >> 1);
        }
        int res = go(row, col + 1, mask >> 1);
        res = max(res, go(row, col + 1, ((mask >> 1) + (1 << (3 * n_int - 1)))));
        res = max(res, (col != 0 && ((mask >> (2 * n_int - 1)) & 1) == 0) ? go(row, col + 1, ((mask >> 1) + (1 << (2 * n_int - 2)))) + 2 : INT_MIN);
        res = max(res, (col != n_int - 1 && ((mask >> (2 * n_int + 1)) & 1) == 0) ? go(row, col + 1, ((mask >> 1) + (1 << (2 * n_int))) ) + 2 : INT_MIN);
        res = max(res, (col >= 2 && ((mask >> (n_int - 2)) & 1) == 0) ? go(row, col + 1, ((mask >> 1) + (1 << (n_int - 3)))) + 2 : INT_MIN);
        res = max(res, (col < n_int - 1 && ((mask >> (n_int + 2)) & 1) == 0) ? go(row, col + 1, ((mask >> 1) + (1 << (n_int + 1)))) + 2 : INT_MIN);
        return answer[row][col][mask] = res;
    }
};

int main() {
    InputReader in;
    OutputWriter out;
    BLittleCLoves3II solver;
    solver.solve(1, in, out);
    return 0;
}
